control.change_summary: Rebuild the complete macOS lifecycle as five self-contained Apple-silicon scripts, remove the distributed shared runtime helper, add stale-lock recovery and line-level error diagnostics, and retain macOS operating-system updates outside the course automation lifecycle.

version_control_system.student_use: Download assignment materials, track file changes, and optionally publish portfolio artifacts.

source_hosting_client.student_use: Authenticate with the approved source-code hosting service and manage course repositories.

programming_language_runtime.student_use: Write, run, and debug Python programs using the course-approved language version.

test_runner.student_use: Run course-provided automated tests and review the results.

coverage_reporter.student_use: Run course-provided coverage checks and review which program statements were exercised.

source_code_ide.student_use: Design, write, test, debug, and manage assignment files.

language_support.student_use: Provide Python language support within the course IDE.

code_quality_tool.student_use: Identify Python style issues and format code consistently.

diagram_support.student_use: View, create, and edit flowcharts and game-world maps.

pseudocode_support.student_use: View, create, and edit pseudocode files with syntax highlighting.

spell_checker.student_use: Check spelling in source code and documentation.

file_viewer.student_use: View course-provided Office and PDF files within the course IDE.
